scripts.features:
I. Fishing Automation (Main Tab)
Auto Cast: Automatically casts fishing rod.
Modes:

* Legit: Simulates mouse clicks, waits for power bar.
* Blatant: Sends cast event with random high power.

Auto Shake: Completes "shake" minigame on bite.
Modes:

* Navigation: Selects UI button, simulates "Enter" key.
* Mouse: Simulates mouse click on shake button.

Auto Reel: Completes "reel" minigame.
Modes:

* Legit: Moves bar to match fish (imperfect).
* Blatant: Fires "reelfinished" event with 100% success.

Zone Specific Casting:

* Bobber length can be set to math.huge.
* Bobber CFrame forced to specific fishing zone.
* UI for zone selection may be hidden but code exists.

II. Exclusives (Exclusives Tab, needs "Rod Of The Depths")
Show Count Shadows: Shows current "Shadows" count in workspace.
Rod Of The Depths Spam: Rapidly equips/unequips rods, adjustable delay.
Dupe Shadow: Attempts item duplication by moving items between backpack and character.
Destroy Shadows: Removes all "Shadows" from workspace.

III. Item Management (Items Tab)
Sell Items:

* Sell All: Sells all items.
* Sell Hand: Sells held item.
* Auto Sell: Periodic selling with adjustable interval.

Treasure Management:

* Teleport to Jack Marrow NPC.
* Repair Map: Equips map and uses repair function.

Collect Treasure:

* Sets proximity prompt hold to 0.
* Teleports to chests and activates prompts.

IV. Teleportation (Teleports Tab)
Area Teleport: Dropdown for game locations/islands.
Totem Teleport: Dropdown for totem locations.
World Event Teleport: Dropdown for active events.
Teleport to Traveler Merchant: Teleports to merchant boat if active.
Create Safe Zone: Creates indestructible high platform, teleports player.

V. Miscellaneous (Misc Tab)
Character Modifications:

* Walk On Water: Makes selected water zones collidable.
* Walk Speed: Slider.
* Jump Height: Slider.
* Noclip: Walk through walls.
* Freeze Character: Anchors character.

Visual & UI Tweaks:

* Bypass Fish Radar: Hides radar UI.
* Bypass GPS: Shows custom XYZ UI.
* Remove Fog: Attempts to remove fog.
* Day Only: Locks time to noon.
* Show/Hide UIs: Toggles HUD visibility.

Utility:

* Hold Duration 0 sec: Instant proximity prompts.
* Disable Oxygen: Stops oxygen drain.
* Copy XYZ: Copies CFrame as Lua code.

Protect Identity:

* Replaces name, coins, level, streak with custom text (default "HIDDEN").
* Custom text input.

VI. Settings (Settings Tab)
UI Configuration: Change theme, accent color (InterfaceManager).
Save/Load Configuration: Save, load, autoload settings (SaveManager).
